value.text: Dasycladus vermicularis (Scopoli) Krasser (Chlorophyta, Dasycladales, Dasycladaceae), a New Record in Taiwan
臺灣新紀錄種海藻－蠕形絨枝藻（綠藻植物門，絨枝藻目，絨枝藻科）
A species of green algae, Dasycladus vermicularis (Scopoli) Krasser, was found at Che-cheng coast of southern Taiwan.
本報告描述2005年4月在南臺灣的車城潮間帶發現的一種海產綠藻－蠕形絨枝藻Dasycladus vermicularis (Scopoli) Krasser.
